capabilities: Generate ChatGPT answers into connected answer notes
Send only the relevant conversation history to save GPT tokens
Maintain context across follow-up questions in a self-contained environment

extras: The README warns that the plugin uploads note content to OpenAI servers, and notes it currently uses GPT-3.5 Turbo with plans to support other models.
problem: Asking follow-up questions to ChatGPT loses context or resends the whole history, wasting tokens and leaving conversations hard to organize in a vault.
